description: This file implements the EventCreator class for network quality event logging, including functions to determine meaningful changes in network metrics and to log network quality changes.

classes.name: EventCreator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and logging network quality change events.

methods.name: MaybeAddNetworkQualityChangedEventToNetLog
methods.description: Checks if network quality metrics have changed meaningfully and logs an event if so.
